_comment: Phase 3 R1 release proof allowlist for tools/phase3-proof/flatdiff.py (format: README.md).

AERO has no entry: its report must be cmp-identical. Revenue, cost of revenue, holder flow and grades get no entry (brief Step 2); the only holder-flow / yields entries are LIT's and PUMP's dilution-derived fields (ruling R21: LIT rel 0.0007, the four net-of-dilution fields rel 0.0008, supply.netPerYear abs 100000; PUMP rel 1e-12). LIT has no unbounded dilution glob (fix round 1): every dilution path is an exact entry, burnedPerYear and emissionsPerYear at abs 0, so a new or removed release line fails.

No todo placeholders remain (controller addendum from the prod-copy run): LIT and VVV list the exact provenance / flags paths that run showed; every other asset showed no provenance / flags / checks diff and gets no entry there.
